# Regression Safety Checklist: GitHub Pilot Issue Ingest and Eligibility

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009C1 requirements preserve existing non-pilot GitHub sync, local task creation, workflow-contract import/export semantics, and feature-flag default behavior while adding only the pilot ingest eligibility gate.
**Created**: 2026-05-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

- [ ] CHK001 Are non-pilot GitHub sync preservation requirements complete enough to keep existing sync behavior unchanged outside the operator-triggered or fixture-driven pilot path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-021, Plan §Summary, Research §Reuse Existing GitHub Sync]
- [ ] CHK002 Are local task creation requirements complete enough to keep existing `/api/tasks` and local-only task creation supported for non-pilot work while excluding local-only tasks from pilot eligibility and source-of-truth evidence?
